checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: add scene picking (SceneHit, raycast_scene, hit_report) that resolves the nearest visible mesh node with filters and JSON-safe reports, and fix non-unit ray distances found while wiring it

impact_assessment.why: Physics raycasts needed caller-built keyed boxes and games/AIs had no way to ask what node is under a ray; picking is a baseline Unity/Unreal capability and the bridge exposed a double-scaling defect in ray_aabb and ray_sphere for non-unit directions.
impact_assessment.benefits: One call resolves a ray to a node with distance and contact point, filters hidden/overlay/layer/ignored content, and reports hits or misses for agent logs; non-unit rays now return true world distances.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new module, three exports, one capability, and a behavior fix in physics for non-unit rays; dependency: picking imports culling, physics, scene; concurrency: none; state: pure queries.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reuse the same visibility and bound rules as navigation, delegate tie-breaking to physics.raycast, pin nearest hit, filters, max distance and non-unit distances with failing-first tests, and keep the canonical evidence unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - keystone/picking.py adds SceneHit, raycast_scene (nearest visible mesh, hidden/overlay/layer/ignore filters, max_distance, id tie-break) and hit_report; ray_aabb and ray_sphere now return world-unit distances for non-unit directions; exports, README section and bullet, ARCHITECTURE row and tree, docs/TREE.md, CHANGELOG and ADR-235 updated; --describe reports capabilities.scene_raycast; 14 picking tests plus the physics regression green (1156 collected), ruff clean, aikit check keystone 6/6 gates, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-picking-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: add word wrapping plus a measured paragraph draw (wrap_text, Canvas.paragraph) so HUD text wraps at the viewport width without games re-implementing layout

impact_assessment.why: The HUD had measured single-line helpers but no wrapping, so every multi-line hint or dialogue re-measured strings; this is the remaining repeated layout code after the widget work.
impact_assessment.benefits: One call draws wrapped, width-safe HUD text with newline and blank-line control and a measured height, discoverable from --describe.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: font and canvas gain functions plus a capability; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no scene or report schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Greedy word wrapping, truncation of overlong words, per-line width tests, validated scale/gap, and an unchanged canonical frame because the engine overlay does not use paragraphs yet.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan (impact-assessed): add keystone.ui.font.wrap_text and Canvas.paragraph with greedy word wrapping, explicit newline and blank-line handling, overlong-word truncation, measured height and a ui_text_wrap capability

impact_assessment.why: Single-line HUD helpers forced every multi-line hint, dialogue or error to re-implement measurement and splitting, the same repeated layout code the widget work removed.
impact_assessment.benefits: Width-safe wrapped HUD text in one measured call, usable by games and AI authors, with wrapped lines exposed for custom layout.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: font/canvas functions plus a capability; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Preserve explicit newlines, truncate overlong words, pin per-line widths and validation, and keep the canonical hash and reference PNG unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - wrap_text and Canvas.paragraph wrap at word boundaries, preserve explicit and blank lines, truncate overlong words, return measured height, and validate scale/gap/width; README, ARCHITECTURE, docs/TREE, CHANGELOG and ADR-236 updated; --describe reports capabilities.ui_text_wrap; 15 text tests green (1171 collected), ruff clean, aikit check keystone 6/6 gates, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-hud-text-v1' completed successfully.

[1/3] Plan: add sphere and box overlap queries over scene bounds (SceneOverlap, overlap_scene, overlap_report) sharing the picking bounds walk, with layer/ignore filters, deterministic distance-then-id ordering and JSON-safe reports

impact_assessment.why: Picking answered ray queries but there was no area query for proximity, triggers or AI perception; callers would rebuild scene bounds exactly as picking did.
impact_assessment.benefits: One scene answers ray and area queries from one bounds rule, with deterministic ordering and reports an AI can log.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: picking gains three exports and a capability; refactor risk in shared bounds walking; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: pure queries.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Factor one _scene_meshes walker used by both queries, keep filters identical, pin ordering and filters with failing-first tests, and keep the canonical evidence unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - picking.py now shares one _scene_meshes bounds walker between ray and area queries and adds SceneOverlap, overlap_scene (Sphere or AABB, layer/ignore filters, distance-then-id ordering) and overlap_report; exports, README, ARCHITECTURE, docs/TREE, CHANGELOG and ADR-237 updated; --describe reports capabilities.scene_overlap; 12 overlap tests plus the picking suite green (1183 collected), ruff clean, aikit check keystone 6/6 gates, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-scene-overlap-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: add bilinear rectangular 2D blend spaces (BlendSample2D, BlendSpace2D) with a complete-grid requirement, canonical sample order, schema-1 documents, strict validation and a discovery flag

impact_assessment.why: Only 1D blend spaces existed, but speed/direction locomotion needs a two-parameter plane; nesting 1D spaces or hand-blending four poses repeats game code and is error-prone.
impact_assessment.benefits: Exact deterministic bilinear weights over a grid, persisted JSON, and a natural locomotion complement to the 1D space that AI clients can inspect.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: animation_blend gains two classes, two exports and a capability; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: schema-1 document is new and does not touch state-machine documents.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Require a complete rectangular grid with actionable errors, store samples in canonical order for stable docs, pin corners/centre/edges/clamping/validation, and keep the canonical evidence unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - BlendSample2D and BlendSpace2D store canonically ordered samples on a complete rectangular grid, clamp each axis, bilinearly blend the surrounding cell via blend_poses and degenerate cleanly for 1xN/Nx1/1x1; schema-1 documents reject unknown fields, incomplete grids and duplicate anchors; exports, README, ARCHITECTURE, docs/TREE, CHANGELOG and ADR-238 updated; --describe reports capabilities.animation_blend_2d; 17 tests green (1200 collected), ruff clean, aikit check keystone 6/6 gates, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-blend2d-v1' completed successfully.

[1/3] Plan: add a deterministic SplitMix64 random stream (RandomStream, RandomStreamState) with reference-vector pinning, unbiased inclusive integers, permutations, labelled forks and snapshot/restore for saves, plus a discovery flag

impact_assessment.why: The engine promises replays and deterministic captures but exposed no cross-version random contract, and one global sequence makes subsystems shift each other and blocks resuming a save mid-run.
impact_assessment.benefits: Games and AI authors get reproducible randomness, independent labelled streams and save/restore, all with data-pinned reference vectors and no new dependency.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new module, two exports and a capability; dependency: none; concurrency: stream state is mutable and caller-owned; state: snapshot schema 1 is new and does not touch scene documents.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pin published SplitMix64 vectors, reject unreachable/invalid inputs, use rejection sampling for randint, prove fork and snapshot behaviour, and keep the canonical evidence unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - keystone/rng.py adds SplitMix64 RandomStream and snapshot RandomStreamState with pinned vectors for seeds 0 and 12345, random/uniform/randint (unbiased inclusive)/choice/shuffled, SHA-256 labelled forks and snapshot/restore; exports, README section and bullet, ARCHITECTURE row and tree, docs/TREE, CHANGELOG and ADR-239 updated; --describe reports capabilities.deterministic_random; 15 tests green (1215 collected), ruff clean, aikit check keystone 6/6 gates after the private-state fix, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; checklists: passed

Task 'keystone-rng-v1' completed successfully.

[1/3] Plan: let AnimationState drive a BlendSpace2D with two parameter names, one-space-only validation, document round trips and report exposure, so the 2D space added in ADR-238 is usable from state machines

impact_assessment.why: BlendSpace2D existed but no consumer could sample it; 2D locomotion still needed game code outside the state machine.
impact_assessment.benefits: One state samples the bilinear grid from live parameters, with schema-1 documents and a discovery flag, while 1D behaviour is unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: AnimationState gains two fields and document keys; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: .kstate documents stay schema 1 and remain backward compatible.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reject both-space states, validate exactly two parameter names, keep the 1D sampler untouched, pin sampling/transitions/documents with failing-first tests, and keep the canonical evidence unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - AnimationState accepts blend_space2d plus exactly two blend_parameters, rejects mixed space kinds, samples live machine parameters through the pose provider, round-trips documents and reports axes/parameters; the 1D path and existing state tests are unchanged; exports not needed, README/ARCHITECTURE/docs/TREE/CHANGELOG and ADR-240 updated; --describe reports capabilities.animation_state_blend_2d; 9 new tests green (1224 collected), ruff clean, aikit check keystone 6/6 gates, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; checklists: passed
